headline: A late-night drive leads to terrorism arrests at RAF base
standfirst: A local resident's 999 call sparked a major security response near a UK military site.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: A local resident called 999 after spotting three suspicious white vans on a country road in Whelford.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Residents in a local WhatsApp group had already flagged suspicious activity near the site overnight.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The alert led police to arrest individuals on suspicion of terrorism near an RAF base.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Ongoing police investigations following the arrests at the military installation.

caption:
A suspicious late-night sighting in Whelford led to police making terrorism arrests near an RAF base.

A local resident called 999 after spotting three white vans on a country road. This prompted a swift response from authorities. The incident highlights the role of neighborhood communication in security.
